faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Kerala?
faqs.answer: September to March is considered the peak season with pleasant weather for Munnar hills, Alleppey backwaters, and Kovalam beaches. June to August (Monsoon) is famous for Ayurvedic wellness treatments.

faqs.question: What is included in the package cost?
faqs.answer: Our packages include dedicated private AC sedan/SUV cab, driver allowances, toll, parking, daily breakfast at hotels, full meals on private houseboat cruises, and 24/7 WhatsApp assistance.

faqs.question: Do you provide pickup from Kochi Airport or Railway Station?
faqs.answer: Yes! All our packages include door-to-door pickup and drop-off from Cochin International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam North/South Railway Station.

faqs.question: Can we customize our itinerary based on our flight timings?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Since we are local tour operators based in Kochi, we can tailor the day-by-day sightseeing and hotel choices according to your flight or train schedule.

title: Munnar Tea Hills & Mist Explorer
highlights: Private AC Cab Pickup from Kochi Airport / Station
Cheeyappara & Valara Waterfalls en route sightseeing
Tea Museum & Guided Tea Plantation Walk in KDHP Estate
Mattupetty Dam Speedboat Ride & Echo Point
Eravikulam National Park (Spot Nilgiri Tahr Mountain Goat)
2 Nights stay in 4-Star Mountain View Resort with Breakfast
description: Immerse yourself in lush greenery, misty valleys, and sprawling tea plantations 1,600 meters above sea level in the queen of hill stations, Munnar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Scenic Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description: Meet and greet at Cochin International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Railway Station. Enjoy a picturesque 4-hour drive to Munnar through rubber plantations, stopping at the breathtaking Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check into your scenic resort and spend the evening enjoying the cool mountain climate.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Munnar Sightseeing & Tea Plantation Tour
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Eravikulam (Rajamalai) National Park to spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr. Tour the Tata Tea Museum for tea tasting. Afternoon drive to Mattupetty Dam for speedboating, followed by scenic photo stops at Echo Point, Kundala Lake, and Blossom Hydel Park.

itinerary.title: Spice Garden Walk & Return Drive to Kochi
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out and visit an authentic Ayurvedic spice garden in Adimali. Learn about cardamom, pepper, cinnamon, and vanilla farming. Drive back to Kochi airport/railway station for your onward journey with sweet memories.

inclusions: Dedicated AC Sedan / SUV cab with professional English/Hindi/Malayalam-speaking driver
All toll taxes, parking fees, driver allowance, and fuel charges
2 Nights accommodation in Deluxe Room with mountain view
24/7 dedicated WhatsApp trip assistance from our local Kochi office
exclusions: Airfare or train tickets to/from Kochi
Entry tickets to National Parks, museums, and boat rides
Anything not explicitly mentioned in inclusions

title: Alleppey Luxury Houseboat Cruise
highlights: Private Deluxe AC Houseboat with Captain, Chef & Engine Driver
Authentic Kerala Welcome Drink & Traditional Sadya Lunch on Board
Scenic cruise through narrow canals, paddy fields & village lagoons
Evening freshly brewed tea with hot Kerala banana fritters (Pazham Pori)
Fresh Pearl Spot Fish (Karimeen Pollichathu) / Chicken Dinner
Night halt in serene backwater lagoon under the stars
description: Drift through the Venice of the East on your exclusive private traditional Kerala Kettuvallam houseboat with personalized service and freshly prepared culinary feasts.

itinerary.title: Board Houseboat in Alleppey & Scenic Backwater Cruise
itinerary.description: Check in at Punnamada Jetty, Alleppey at 12:00 PM with tender coconut welcome drinks. Sail along the Punnamada Lake, Vembanad lake, and rural backwater canals. Enjoy a freshly prepared Kerala lunch with traditional fish fry. In the evening, the boat anchors in a tranquil village lagoon for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Morning Cruise, Traditional Breakfast & Departure
itinerary.description: Wake up to the gentle chirping of birds and misty water reflections. Enjoy hot Appam with Vegetable/Egg Stew or Idli/Dosa breakfast while the boat cruises back to the boarding jetty by 9:30 AM. Private cab drop to Kochi.

inclusions: Private exclusive AC Deluxe Houseboat for your party
All meals on board: Welcome Drink, Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, Dinner, and Breakfast
Private AC cab pickup and drop from Kochi or Alleppey station
Full crew services: dedicated private Chef, Captain, and Guide
exclusions: Canoe ride through ultra-narrow village waterways (optional add-on)

title: Wayanad Nature & Waterfalls Escape
highlights: Edakkal Caves ancient petroglyphs exploration
Banasura Sagar Dam (Largest earthen dam in India) & speedboating
Soochipara Waterfalls & Meenmutty trek
Rainforest treehouse / luxury plantation villa stay
Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary Jeep Safari
description: Escape to the misty highlands, pristine rainforests, gushing waterfalls, and historical caves of Wayanad in North Kerala.

itinerary.title: Calicut Pickup & Wayanad Ghats Mountain Drive
itinerary.description: Pickup from Calicut (CCJ) Airport or Railway Station. Scenic drive ascending the famous 9 Thamarassery hair-pin curves with panoramic viewpoint stops. Check into your rainforest resort.

itinerary.title: Edakkal Caves & Soochipara Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Hike to the historic Edakkal Caves atop Ambukuthi hills to view Neolithic rock carvings. Afternoon visit to the three-tiered Soochipara waterfalls with natural rock pools.

itinerary.title: Banasura Sagar Dam & Pookode Lake
itinerary.description: Explore the islands of Banasura Sagar earthen dam with speedboating. In the afternoon, enjoy paddle boating surrounded by lush evergreen forests at Pookode freshwater lake.

itinerary.title: Spice Shopping & Departure from Calicut
itinerary.description: Check out, visit local spice and Wayanad honey markets, and transfer to Calicut airport/station.

inclusions: Private AC Cab for 4 Days from Calicut / Kochi
3 Nights luxury resort accommodation with breakfast
exclusions: Entry tickets to monuments and adventure activities

title: Kovalam Beach & Poovar Island Retreat
highlights: Lighthouse Beach, Hawa Beach, and Samudra Beach
Poovar Golden Sand Island & Mangrove Forest Boat Safari
Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple architectural tour in Trivandrum
Authentic Kerala Ayurvedic Full Body Herbal Massage session
Day excursion to Kanyakumari (Cape Comorin - meeting of 3 oceans)
description: Experience golden sand coastlines, historic temples, luxury beachside resorts, and rejuvenating Ayurvedic therapies in South Kerala.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Trivandrum & Transfer to Kovalam Beach
itinerary.description: Pickup from Trivandrum (TRV) airport or station. Check into your beachfront resort. Evening at leisure at Lighthouse Beach promenade.

itinerary.title: Trivandrum City Sightseeing & Temple Visit
itinerary.description: Morning visit to the magnificent Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Napier Museum, and Kuthiramalika Palace.

itinerary.title: Poovar Island Estuary & Mangrove Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Excursion to Poovar where the river, lake, and Arabian Sea converge. Boat cruise through dense mangrove forest tunnels.

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Kanyakumari & Vivekananda Rock
itinerary.description: Drive to Kanyakumari, visit Vivekananda Rock Memorial and Thiruvalluvar statue via ferry boat, and watch the spectacular sunset.

itinerary.title: Ayurveda Rejuvenation & Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a 60-minute relaxing Ayurvedic massage session. Transfer to Trivandrum airport/station for departure.

inclusions: 4 Nights Beach Resort stay with daily breakfast
